findings.description: The 'Phase A crate graph' prose (lines 23-40) was not updated when r-3b landed. It still says 'Only the composition roots sc-ai and sc-jev-py depend on full sc-observability' and draws sc-ai and sc-jev-py linking sc-observability directly. The binding ADR-SAG-0013 r-3b amendment, the ADR-SAG-0010 r-3b amendment, the A.1 graph at lines 66-97 and crates/sc-jev-host/Cargo.toml:27 all say sc-jev-host is the only crate that links sc-observability. The Cargo manifests of sc-ai and sc-jev-py show no sc-observability dependency. The repo-level architecture doc therefore contradicts its own Active ADRs. The graph at lines 23-35 also omits sc-jev-host, sc-agent-http and sc-decision-schema. The 'starting point' note at line 83 does not cover the false sentence at 38-40.
findings.remediation: Rewrite lines 23-49 to the integrated shape. Either delete the Phase A graph or mark it historical, and change the sentence at lines 38-40 to say sc-jev-host is the only crate linking sc-observability. Confirm docs/sc-ai, docs/sc-jev-py and docs/sc-jev-host/architecture.md use the same wording.
